text:
alerts-bot: :rotating_light: Incident 1763876543 

ops_lead: Observed elevated latency and intermittent 5xx from /v1/stream and /v1/generate for a subset of Dedicated tenants in us-central. Triage call in 5. Severity P2. Chris and Raj take primary, Emily prepare customer note.

chris_sre: 95p token latency ~3x on serving multiplexer, autoscaler not adding pods. Logs show `scale-controller: reconcile error: timeout`.

raj_infra: Manually scaling us-central-dedicated from 10 -> 15: `kubectl scale --replicas=15 deploy/us-central-dedicated -n redwood-serving`. Warming caches. Disabling flag `enable_smooth_scale=false`.

maya.dev: Are we risking cross-region fallbacks? Some apps reported failovers to eu-west.

chris_sre: Keeping routing sticky. Throttling eu-west fallbacks for affected customers (fallback-throttle=50rps). Restarting scale-controller leader lease.

emily_pm: Posted status update: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/usc-01. Short blurb and CS notified.

oncall-bot: Incident state: investigating -> mitigation_in_progress. Pager acknowledged.

raj_infra: Restarted controller: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/scale-controller -n redwood-controlplane`. Controller re-acquired leader lock; scale events allowed.

chris_sre: After manual scale + restart, 95p latency down from ~1.8s -> ~450ms. 5xx <0.1%. Monitoring for 20m.

ops_lead: Declare mitigated once stable for 40m then postmortem. Emily, customer follow-up in 30m with root cause.

emily_pm: Sent customer comms and CS notes. Postmortem skeleton created: cause = autoscaler controller regression, mitigation = manual scale + restart + flag revert, next = rollback patch and add staging gate.

oncall-bot: Incident state: mitigation_in_progress -> monitoring -> resolved. Postmortem: https://confluence.redwood.ai/incidents/usc-01/postmortem

mayadev: Thanks team :thumbsup:
